versions.changelog: When you want to use Wilma in your browser, ask your assistant to log out of Wilma, or run wilma logout.
Agents now see 'Update available' notices from the CLI; the skill tells them to run wilma update after finishing the request. Needs wilma-cli 2.1.0 for agent notices.

For WilmAI CLI 2.0. Every child by default; the same JSON as the MCP tools; Finnish times with their offset; short commands (schedule tomorrow, messages <id>, news <id>); gradebook, printouts, lesson-note summaries and exam start times. Uses the WilmAI MCP tools when connected. The bundled script runs CLI 2.x, through npx while 1.x is installed; run wilma update to update the CLI. Dates in the reader's language style.

Attempt-based resource downloads: every bulletin link is a downloadable resource; statuses downloaded / not_a_file / error. Rewritten agent guidance for the resources array. Pairs with wilma-cli 1.6.0.
Add attendance/lesson notes (merkinnät) support: wilma attendance list command, --all-students flag, date filtering, hour mapping from thead colspans
Add MFA (TOTP) support for Wilma accounts with persistent secret storage
Add --date and --weekday flags for schedule lookup (supports Finnish short forms: ma, ti, ke, to, pe)

Wilma Skill 1.2.0 adds formalized metadata for platform compatibility.

- Added _meta.json file for skill metadata.
- Enhanced SKILL.md with a new "metadata" section describing required local config files, dependencies, install instructions, and authentication notes.
- No breaking changes to CLI usage or core documentation.
Add summary, schedule, homework, grades commands. Powered by the Wilma /overview endpoint.
Finnish school system (Wilma) CLI skill — fetch messages, news, exams for AI agents
